request: I can't decide whether we renew the Tallyhouse log contract until Dana in security weighs in, and she's slammed this month. My notes are in notes/renewal.md. Write up what I need from her as questions-for-dana.md so she can work through it on her own time.
skill_step: The questionnaire follows a fixed template: a Purpose line, a From / To / How your answers will be used line, Context and How to answer sections, one single-idea question per heading with an empty answer stub (a lone '>') under every question, a 'Why this matters' line only on questions that could be misread, and an 'Anything else?' catch-all.

checks.why: the document is where the request asked for it
it is about the log contract in notes/renewal.md
it actually asks Dana several questions
every question gets an empty answer stub (a lone '>') beneath it

checks.pattern: how your answers will be used
checks.why: the header names how the recipient's answers will be used
markers: how your answers will be used

checks.why: questions that could be misread carry a 'Why this matters' line
